_note: All movement and body numbers live here so the game can be tuned without touching code. Speeds are in mountain time.
_slopes: Slopes are from a 31 m elevation grid, which smooths real faces: a 45 degree cell hides much steeper steps.
_limits: Fixed ropes are the only aid. Walk below climb_start_deg; scramble (slow, tiring) up to no_rope_max_deg; above that only on a fixed rope. Unroped, ground steeper than the surface's stand_deg makes you slide. Clipped in, you can climb anything near the rope.
_rope: Clipped in, you move freely up to rope_leash_m from the rope. Moving along it gets the jumar speed; the rope steers you gently back toward its line and catches slips.
_altitude_pace: Speed multiplier for an acclimatized climber without bottled oxygen.
_slips: Chance per mountain minute of slipping when scrambling unroped at the no-rope limit, rising from climb_start_deg, scaled by pushing and the surface. Standing still is safer but not safe.
_surfaces: speed: walking/climbing pace multiplier. stand_deg: steeper than this unroped and you slide. friction: sliding friction (you slide on anything steeper than atan(friction)). arrest: extra friction from self-arresting. slip: how slippery it is to scramble on. impact: how much a hard hit on it hurts.
_falls: Falls run in real seconds. A fall starts as a slide: hold Space to self-arrest, which only works below self_arrest_below_m_s and within arrest_window_s. Faster than tumble_above_m_s, or after a hard hit, you tumble. Damage comes from how hard you hit the ground (speed into it above safe_impact, squared, times impact_damage and the surface's impact) and from scraping over rock at speed, never from distance alone.
